'html': standalone static HTML with all elements visible. Use animationSteps:true with 'html' to get Reveal.js with step navigation.

animationSteps.description: Only relevant when format:'html'. If true, generates Reveal.js HTML with step-by-step animation navigation. Default false (all elements visible at once).

scale.description: Only for format:'image'. Capture scale factor (default 0.5, giving 960x540px JPEG). Use 1.0 for full 1920x1080.

outputPath.description: Optional absolute path to write the output file (.jpg for image, .html for html). If omitted, content is returned inline.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_getImageDimensions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns {width, height, format} for a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image given a local file path or http/https URL. Only reads the first 512 bytes (Range header for URLs). Use this before inserting an image block to get correct w/h values — required because image style.maxHeight/maxWidth only constrain the wrapper div, not the image itself, without explicit w/h on the block.

src.description: Local absolute file path or http/https URL of the image.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_duplicateSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Clones a slide (with all its blocks) and inserts the copy immediately after the original. All block IDs are regenerated. Useful for reveal-step variants and before/after comparisons.

slideIndex.description: 1-based index of the slide to duplicate. Defaults to currently visible slide.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_insertSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Inserts a single slide. For inserting many slides at once, prefer wolfslide_bulkInsert. To rebuild an existing slide, use wolfslide_replaceSlide. Block types: container, heading, text, image, list, math, box, code, arrow, eval, raw. list items may be plain strings (auto-wrapped to text blocks) or {type:"text",content}; eval blocks accept the expression in `input` (or `content`). Content supports KaTeX math via $...$ (inline) and $$...$$ (display); fragmentOrder:N for animation; CSS classes .gl .te .ro .mu .bl .re .cy for colored text. If afterIndex is omitted, appends at the end.

Minimal example: {label:"Title", background:"#1a1a2e", layout:"column", children:[{type:"heading", content:"Hello"}, {type:"text", content:"Body text here."}]}

slide.description: Slide object. Required: label. Optional: background, layout (column/row/grid), gap, padding, children:[{type, content, style, ...}]. Block types: container, heading, text, image, list, math, box, code, arrow, eval, raw.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_replaceSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Replaces an entire slide's structure in one call — the first-class way to REBUILD a slide (no insert+delete index juggling). The target slide's id is preserved by default so references stay stable; pass slide.id to override. To change only a few block properties, prefer wolfslide_patchBlock; to change only slide metadata (label/background/layout), prefer wolfslide_editSlide. Block types: container, heading, text, image, list, math, box, code, arrow, eval, raw. List items may be plain strings or {type:"text",content}. Eval blocks accept the expression in `input` (or `content`).

Example: wolfslide_replaceSlide(slideIndex:3, slide:{label:"Recap", layout:"column", children:[{type:"heading", content:"Recap"}, {type:"list", items:["point one", "point two"]}]})

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number to replace (matches wolfslide_listSlides). Omit to target the currently visible slide.

slideId.description: Slide id to replace (alternative to slideIndex).

slide.description: The full replacement slide. Optional: label, background, layout (column/row/grid), gap, padding, children:[{type, content, ...}]. The existing slide id is kept unless you set slide.id.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_editSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Updates SLIDE-LEVEL metadata only: label, background, layout, gap, padding, hidden, transition, notes, align, justify, scale, baseFontSize. Omit slideIndex to target the currently visible slide.

LAYOUT/FILL helpers: align (cross-axis: flex-start/center/flex-end/stretch) and justify (main-axis: flex-start/center/flex-end/space-between/space-around) control alignment on the slide root — e.g. patch:{justify:"center"} vertically centers a column slide to kill bottom whitespace. scale (number, default 1) multiplies the built-in base text + heading sizes to enlarge a whole slide (e.g. scale:1.2); baseFontSize (px) is an alias (relative to 36). Block-level inline fontSize still overrides.

🚫 NEVER use this to change block properties. For any block change (style, content, position, etc.) use wolfslide_patchBlock — it finds the block anywhere in the tree by id and never risks losing sibling blocks.

Children arrays: the ONLY safe use is pure id-only stubs {"id":"..."} for reordering top-level blocks. ANY entry with extra fields (style, offset, content, etc.) is REJECTED with an error before saving — the tool will tell you which blocks to patch and with what call.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number matching the thumbnail panel (same as the number shown as 'Slide N' in wolfslide_listSlides). Pass 15 to target slide 15.

patch.description: Slide metadata fields to update: label, background, layout, gap, padding, hidden, transition, notes, align (cross-axis alignment of the slide root), justify (main-axis alignment — e.g. 'center' to vertically center a column slide), scale (font-size multiplier, default 1), baseFontSize (px alias for scale). For block changes, use wolfslide_patchBlock or wolfslide_block instead.

dryRun.description: When true and patch includes a children/items/elements array: compute the diff (blocks preserved, patched, added, DELETED) and return it WITHOUT saving. Use this to verify no blocks are accidentally deleted before committing. Required when passing a children array to avoid silent data loss.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_deleteSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Removes a slide by 1-based panel number (slideIndex, same as 'Slide N' in wolfslide_listSlides) or by id.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number matching the thumbnail panel (same as 'Slide N' in wolfslide_listSlides).

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_deleteSlides
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes multiple slides in one call. Provide either slideIndices (array of 1-based slide numbers, e.g. [3,5,7]) OR from+to (1-based inclusive range, e.g. from:5 to:27). At least one slide must remain. Use this instead of repeated wolfslide_deleteSlide calls when removing several slides.

slideIndices.description: Array of 1-based slide indices to delete (e.g. [3, 5, 7]).

from.description: 1-based start of the range to delete (inclusive). Used with 'to'.

to.description: 1-based end of the range to delete (inclusive). Used with 'from'.

docUri.description: URI of the .wslide document. Defaults to the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_moveSlide
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Moves a slide to a new position. toIndex is 1-based (the desired final position).

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide number matching the thumbnail panel (same as 'Slide N' in wolfslide_listSlides). Required unless using slideId.

toIndex.description: Target 1-based index. Use 1 to move to the first position. Using 0 is treated the same as 1.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_undo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reverts the last programmatic change made to the deck via MCP tools (uses an extension-host undo stack, independent of VS Code Ctrl+Z). Effective for undoing wolfslide_editSlide, wolfslide_insertSlide, wolfslide_deleteSlide, wolfslide_block, and other deck-modifying tools. Stack depth: 20. Optionally specify docUri to target a specific file.

docUri.description: Optional URI of the .wslide file to undo in. Defaults to the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_reload
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Re-reads the .wslide file from disk and resets the in-memory deck to its saved state. Clears the undo stack. Use this after an external tool or script has modified the file directly, or when the in-memory deck has drifted from disk and you need a clean baseline.

docUri.description: Optional URI of the .wslide file to reload. Defaults to the active editor.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_saveFile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Persists the current deck to disk. Call after editing slides to ensure changes are saved.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_exportHtml
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Exports the deck as a standalone Reveal.js HTML file (images inlined as data URIs). Returns the path of the exported file.

outputPath.description: Optional output file path. Defaults to <deckName>.html next to the .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_insertEvalBlock
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inserts a Mathematica evaluable block on a slide. Graphics (Plot, Graphics, etc.) render as crisp SVG; symbolic expressions (Integrate, Series, etc.) render as beautifully typeset LaTeX via KaTeX; fallback is PNG. Auto-evaluates immediately by default. Use this for computed plots, formulas, diagrams, or any dynamic Wolfram Language output in presentations.

parentBlockId.description: Optional parent container block id to insert into.

w.description: Image width in pixels for rasterization. Default: 800.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_runEvalBlock
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Evaluates (or re-evaluates) an existing eval block on a slide. Optionally updates the input expression before running. Graphics produce SVG, symbolic math produces LaTeX (KaTeX), with PNG fallback. Returns the evaluation result type (svg/latex/image/text/error).

input.description: Optional new Mathematica expression. If omitted, re-runs the existing input.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_setTheme
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Sets the deck's color theme from a preset or custom values. Presets: 'academic-light' (white/navy, formal), 'dark-modern' (dark/gold/teal, tech), 'dark-navy' (deep navy/blue), 'solarized-dark' (warm dark), 'high-contrast' (black/neon), 'warm-cream' (light warm). Also updates slide backgrounds to match. Call wolfslide_getContext to see all presets with descriptions. For custom themes, pass a theme object with keys: navy, blue, cyan, accent, editorCSS.

INCREMENTAL editorCSS edits (avoid resending the whole editorCSS blob): pass appendEditorCSS to append a snippet, or editorCSSReplace as [{find,replace}] (or [[find,replace]]) literal string substitutions on the current editorCSS. Either can be standalone or combined with preset/theme. (editorCSS affects the Reveal.js export and raw-block iframes, not the editor's built-in slide typography.)

theme.description: Custom theme object with color keys: navy, blue, cyan, accent, editorCSS. Used when preset is not specified.

defaultBackground.description: Background color to apply to all slides that currently have default backgrounds.

applyBackground.description: Whether to update slide backgrounds to match the preset. Default: true.

stylePresets.description: Named style bundles stored at deck level. Each key is a preset name; value is a CSS object (background, color, fontSize, etc.) applied as base styles to any block with that stylePreset name. Set a key to null to delete that preset. Example: { "section-header": { "background": "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)", "color": "#fff" } }

appendEditorCSS.description: Append this CSS snippet to the deck's existing editorCSS — lets you add one rule without resending the whole blob.

editorCSSReplace.description: Literal find/replace edits applied to the current editorCSS, e.g. [{"find":"font-size:48px","replace":"font-size:56px"}] or [["old","new"]]. Each find that is not present is reported as not-found. Tweak one rule without resending everything.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_bulkInsert
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Inserts multiple slides in one call — use this when building a presentation from scratch instead of calling insertSlide repeatedly. Block types MUST be one of: container, heading, text, image, list, math, box, code, arrow, eval, raw — passing an unknown type returns a validation error before inserting anything. Content supports KaTeX math via $...$ / $$...$$; fragmentOrder:N for animation; CSS color classes .gl .te .ro .mu .bl .re .cy. Tip: call wolfslide_getContext first to see theme presets.

Minimal slide: {label:"Slide title", background:"#1a1a2e", layout:"column", children:[{type:"heading", content:"Title"}, {type:"text", content:"Body."}]}

slides.description: Array of slide objects. Each slide: {label, background, layout (column/row/grid), gap, padding, children:[{type, content, style, ...}]}. REQUIRED per block: type. Block types: container, heading, text, image, list, math, box, code, arrow, eval, raw.

afterIndex.description: Insert after this 1-based index. 0 = prepend. Default: append at end.

theme.description: Theme preset name (string) or custom theme object to apply to the deck.

meta.description: Deck metadata to set, e.g. {title: 'My Talk', author: 'Name'}.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_getCellOutput
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read committed text/plain output and MCP-side execution provenance without re-running the cell. State is one of never-run, running, success-with-output, success-Null, completed-with-messages, failed, aborted, stale, or unknown (for example after a kernel restart or for output loaded from disk without current-session provenance).

cellId.description: Stable CellId of the cell (preferred over cellNumber).

cellNumber.description: 1-based cell number. Use cellId when available.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_validateSyntax
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check Wolfram Language syntax in one or more cells using the kernel's SyntaxQ. Returns a list of cells with syntax errors. Falls back to offline bracket-matching when the kernel is not running.

cellId.description: Stable CellId to validate (single cell, preferred over cellNumber after reordering).

cellNumber.description: Check a single cell by 1-based number. Use cellId when available.

endCell.description: Range: last cell to check (inclusive, 1-based). Defaults to last cell.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_latex
languageModelTools.modelDescription: LaTeX workflow tool: save .tex files, compile to PDF via latexmk, and parse compilation errors. Actions: 'save' writes .tex to disk, 'compile' runs latexmk, 'errors' parses the .log for errors/warnings, 'build' does save→compile→errors in one call. Requires latexmk (TeX Live / MacTeX).

action.description: save: write .tex to disk. compile: run latexmk. errors: parse .log for errors. build: save + compile + return errors.

path.description: Path to .tex file (absolute or relative to notebook dir).

content.description: LaTeX source content (required for 'save' and 'build' actions).

content_encoding.description: Decode mode for content. Control characters are preserved with a warning for TeX compatibility.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_searchSlides
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Search slides by label OR block content — use this to find the correct slideIndex BEFORE editing, especially when slide labels are not unique (e.g. 'N=4 SYM via QSC' on multiple slides). A query matches both slide labels and block text content. Returns slideIndex for every match so you can pass it directly to edit tools.

Examples:
  wolfslide_searchSlides(query:"Spectrum from FME")  ← find which slide number has this label
  wolfslide_searchSlides(query:"gamma_cusp")           ← find which slides contain this equation
  wolfslide_searchSlides(blockType:"image")            ← list all slides with images
  wolfslide_searchSlides(query:"red", styleKey:"color")  ← find blocks with color containing 'red'

Also supports blockType (exact block type filter) and styleKey+styleValue (CSS property search). All filters can be combined.

query.description: Text to search for (case-insensitive). Optional when blockType or styleKey is provided.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

styleKey.description: Style property name to filter on (e.g. "color", "fontSize", "background"). Combined with styleValue for exact matching.

styleValue.description: Style property value to match (partial, case-insensitive). Requires styleKey.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_block
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Block-level operations on slide blocks.

action="insert": add a new block to a slide.
action="edit": patch a block's properties by blockId or blockName (for SIMPLE property changes prefer wolfslide_patchBlock; this action adds childrenOps for precise child-array edits; null value = delete key).
action="delete": remove a block by blockId or blockName.
action="move": relocate a block within or between containers (by blockId or blockName).
action="bulkEdit": apply many explicit {blockId, updates} edits in one atomic save.
action="getBlock": retrieve full JSON of one block by blockId or blockName.
action="bulkPatch": apply the SAME patch to every block matching a selector across the entire deck — the efficient way to normalize styles, apply presets, or fix many blocks at once.

bulkPatch selector keys: type (block type), className, namePattern (glob, e.g. 'title-*'), blockIds (explicit array), hasStyle ({key:value} match), stylePreset. All selector keys are ANDed.
Example: wolfslide_block({ action:'bulkPatch', selector:{type:'box'}, patch:{stylePreset:'section-header'} })

action.description: insert: add a new block. edit: patch block properties. delete: remove a block. move: relocate a block. bulkEdit: many explicit {blockId,updates} edits in one save. getBlock: fetch full JSON of one block. bulkPatch: apply the same patch to all blocks matching a selector across the deck.

blockId.description: Target block ID (for edit/delete/move/getBlock). Use blockName as a stable alternative.

blockName.description: Human-readable name of the block (alternative to blockId for edit/delete/move/getBlock). Set via the 'name' field at creation. Searched across all slides.

block.description: Block object to insert (required for 'insert'). Include type, content, and optionally a 'name' field for future addressing.

updates.description: Properties to patch on the block (for 'edit'). Also accepted as 'patch'. null value = delete key. Include childrenOps:[{op:'insert',afterId,block},{op:'remove',blockId},{op:'reorder',ids}] for precise child array ops without replacing the whole array.

parentBlockId.description: Insert/move into this container block (for insert/move).

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

edits.description: Array of block edits for action='bulkEdit'. Each item: {blockId, updates (or patch), slideId? or slideIndex?}. blockId is required; slideId/slideIndex are optional (auto-searched across all slides if omitted).

selector.description: Selector for action='bulkPatch'. Supported keys: type (block type string), className (exact CSS class name), namePattern (glob e.g. 'title-*'), blockIds (explicit id array), hasStyle ({cssKey: 'value'} — exact match on style properties), stylePreset (preset name string). All keys are ANDed. Must match at least one block or returns an error.

patch.description: Patch to apply to each matched block (for action='bulkPatch'). Deep-merged using same rules as wolfslide_patchBlock: nested objects merge key-by-key, null = delete key, arrays replace entirely.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_patchBlock
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Merge a patch into a single block, OR inspect a block's current JSON — both by blockId or blockName. Finds the block recursively across all slides. THE preferred tool for changing any block property (color, style, content, size, position, etc.). Setting a value to null removes that key. Style properties merge deeply: { style: { background: 'red' } } only changes background, leaving other style keys intact.

Inspect (no patch): wolfslide_patchBlock(blockId: "9c0rx643")  ← returns current JSON without modifying
Patch by ID: wolfslide_patchBlock(blockId: "9c0rx643", patch: {style: {background: "red"}})
Patch by name: wolfslide_patchBlock(blockName: "slide-title", patch: {...})  ← stable across re-inserts

Style preset: add stylePreset:"preset-name" to a block patch to apply a named style bundle (created via wolfslide_setTheme(stylePresets:{...})). The preset supplies base styles; block.style always overrides.

Supported block style keys: background, color, borderRadius, border, boxShadow, padding, margin, fontSize, fontWeight, fontStyle, lineHeight, textAlign, letterSpacing, opacity, flex, alignSelf, overflow, whiteSpace, textShadow, backdropFilter, transform.

blockId.description: ID of the block to patch (e.g. '9c0rx643'). Found in wolfslide_listSlides verbose output or wolfslide_getSlide ASCII tree. Use blockName instead for named blocks.

blockName.description: Human-readable name of the block (alternative to blockId). Set via the 'name' field at block creation (e.g. name:'slide-title'). Searched across all slides — more stable than ID across re-inserts.

patch.description: Properties to merge into the block. Deep-merged: nested objects (like style) are merged key-by-key. Set a key to null to delete it. Arrays are replaced entirely. Omit entirely (or pass null) to inspect the block's current JSON without modifying it.

slideIndex.description: Optional: 1-based slide index to narrow the search. If omitted, searches the currently visible slide first, then all other slides. When the user says 'this slide', omit this and the tool will target the current slide.

slideId.description: Slide ID to narrow the search (alternative to slideIndex).

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_advanced
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Advanced slide operations. Actions: 'duplicate' deep-copies a slide (alias of wolfslide_duplicateSlide — prefer that tool), 'check' audits the entire deck for issues (empty slides, missing alt-text, fragment gaps, duplicate labels), 'reorderFragments' sets animation step order on a slide, 'measure' returns rendered block sizes and detects overflow.

action.description: duplicate: copy a slide. check: audit deck for issues. reorderFragments: set animation order. measure: get rendered block sizes.

order.description: Fragment order array for 'reorderFragments'. Each entry: blockId string or {blockId, step} object.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_arrange
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Align and/or distribute free-positioned (position:"absolute") blocks on a slide in one call. Pass 'align' and/or 'distribute' (both applied: align first, then distribute). Operates on the blocks named by 'blockIds', or on ALL absolute-positioned blocks on the slide when blockIds is omitted. Only blocks with position:"absolute" and numeric x/y/w/h are affected — flow/column blocks are skipped (give them position:"absolute" via wolfslide_patchBlock first). Alignment is relative to the selection's bounding box by default, or to the whole slide with relativeTo:"slide". Distribute needs 3+ blocks and evenly spaces their centres (first & last stay put). Changes are saved and the editor refreshes.

align.description: Align edge/axis: left|right|hcenter align horizontally; top|bottom|vcenter align vertically. Omit to only distribute.

distribute.description: Space the blocks' centres evenly along this axis (needs 3+ blocks). Omit to only align.

relativeTo.description: Alignment reference for 'align': 'selection' = the blocks' bounding box (default for 2+ blocks); 'slide' = the 1920×1080 canvas (default for a single block).

blockIds.description: Block ids to arrange. If omitted, all absolute-positioned blocks on the slide are used.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide index. If omitted, resolved from blockIds, else the first slide.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_copySlides
languageModelTools.displayName: Wolfslide: Copy Slides to Another Deck
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Copies one or more slides from a source .wslide file to a target .wslide file, including all referenced image assets. Images are copied to the target deck's img/ folder and src paths are automatically updated. Both files must be open in the editor. Specify slides with slideIndices (array of 1-based numbers) or from+to (1-based inclusive range). If neither is given, copies the currently visible slide from the source. Use wolfslide_getContext to find the docUri of each open file. After copying, the target deck is saved and its editor refreshes.

sourceDocUri.description: URI of the source .wslide file (as shown in wolfslide_getContext). Defaults to the currently active editor.

targetDocUri.description: URI of the destination .wslide file. Must be open in the editor. Get URIs from wolfslide_getContext.

slideIndices.description: 1-based slide numbers to copy from the source (e.g. [1, 3, 5]). Use this OR from+to.

from.description: 1-based start of a contiguous range to copy (inclusive). Use with 'to'.

to.description: 1-based end of the range to copy (inclusive). Use with 'from'.

insertAtIndex.description: 1-based position in the target deck where the slides should be inserted. Defaults to appending at the end.

languageModelTools.name: wolfslide_imageAsset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Manage image assets for the active .wslide deck. Image files live in img/<deckName>.wslide/ next to the .wslide file. Each image can have a sidecar annotation file (.ann.json) with description, source, and tags. Actions: 'list' — show all images with sizes, dimensions, which slides use them, and any annotation; 'info' — full details + ready-to-paste block JSON for one image; 'copy' — import an external image file into the deck folder (returns the relative src path and a ready-to-use block snippet); 'delete' — remove an image (warns if still referenced by a block, use force:true to override); 'rename' — rename a file AND automatically update all block src references in the deck; 'annotate' — write/update description, source, tags for an image (stored in .ann.json sidecar beside the image); 'insert' — copy an image AND immediately insert an image block into a slide in one combined call. Block src format: "img/<deckName>.wslide/<filename>". Always use this tool to add images — never construct src paths manually.

action.description: list: all images. info: details for one file. copy: import external file. delete: remove file. rename: rename + update refs. annotate: set description/source/tags. insert: copy + add block to slide.

filename.description: Target filename within the deck's img/ folder (e.g. 'spectrum_plot.png'). Used by: info, delete, rename, annotate, insert.

srcPath.description: Absolute path to the source file on disk. Used by: copy, insert.

annotation.description: String (description) or object {description, source, tags[]} to save as .ann.json sidecar. Used by: copy, insert, annotate.

slideIndex.description: 1-based slide index to insert the image block into. Used by: insert.

slideId.description: Slide id (alternative to slideIndex). Used by: insert.

targetBlockId.description: If provided, the image block is appended as a child of this container block (for insertion into nested layouts). Used by: insert.

w.description: Display width in pixels for the inserted image block. Defaults to image's native width (capped at 1600).

h.description: Display height in pixels for the inserted image block. Defaults to image's native height (capped at 900).

fit.description: Object-fit mode for the inserted image block. Default: 'contain'.

style.description: Optional CSS style object for the inserted image block.

fragmentOrder.description: Animation step for the inserted image block.

overwrite.description: For action:'copy' — if true, overwrite the destination file if it already exists, keeping the original filename. Default false (safe: appends timestamp to avoid collision). Use overwrite:true when re-exporting a plot so the slide keeps the same src reference.

force.description: For action:'delete' — delete even if the image is still referenced by slide blocks.

docUri.description: Optional: target a specific open .wslide file.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_runCells
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a contiguous range of notebook cells sequentially and return their combined output. Use startCell/endCell (1-based cell numbers) to specify the range. Cells are run in order; if stopOnError is true (default), execution stops on the first error. Returns a summary line per cell showing output or error. Prefer this over repeated wolfbook_runCell calls when executing consecutive cells.

startCell.description: 1-based cell number to start from (inclusive). Defaults to 1.

endCell.description: 1-based cell number to end at (inclusive). Defaults to last cell.

stopOnError.description: Stop execution if a cell produces an error. Default true.

timeoutSeconds.description: Global timeout in seconds for the entire range. Default 120.

notebook.description: Notebook filename to target. Defaults to the active open notebook.

caption.description: Short human-readable reminder of what this operation is doing.

wait_mode.description: Return immediately with an operation ID when async; otherwise wait up to timeoutSeconds.

progress_symbol.description: Optional Wolfram symbol to sample during execution.

stop_on_failure.description: Stop only on structured failure; default true.

languageModelTools.name: wolfbook_showImage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a local image file and return it as an inline image so you can visually verify plot output, exported PNGs, etc. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG. Files larger than 4 MB are rejected. Use this after wolfbook_runCell exports a PNG to confirm the visual result before referencing it in a slide.

path.description: Absolute path to the image file to display.

languageModelTools.name: paper_getOutline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Structural outline of a LaTeX paper: nested sections, per-kind object counts, managed Mathematica block states, and parse warnings. Start here before any other paper_* call. Set include_project for the root file and the \\input/\\include graph. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

include_project.description: Also resolve the root file and walk the \\input/\\include graph.

languageModelTools.name: paper_getObject
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch one semantic object (equation, figure, table, paragraph, section, theorem) from a LaTeX paper with its source text, line range and sourceHash. Address it by \\label, stableKey, or objectId. The returned sourceHash is what you pass to paper_applyEdit as expected_source_hash. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

selector.description: A \\label (e.g. eq:dispersion), a stableKey, or an objectId.

include_neighbours.description: Also return the preceding and following objects.

languageModelTools.name: paper_getSection
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetch a section of a LaTeX paper and every addressable object inside it. Selector matches a heading by \\label, stableKey, or a substring of its title; omit it for the first section. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

selector.description: Heading label, stableKey, or part of its title.

languageModelTools.name: paper_findReferences
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cross-reference health for a LaTeX paper. With `name`: where that label is declared, what object it names, and everything that \\ref or \\cite-s it. Without: all unresolved refs, duplicate labels and unused labels in the file. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

name.description: A label or citation key. Omit for a whole-file report.

languageModelTools.name: paper_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the objects of the OPEN LaTeX paper by text, returning matching equations/paragraphs/figures with excerpts and their stableKeys. This searches the user's own document; for published literature use wolfbook_paperSearch instead. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

query.description: Text to find, or a regular expression when regex is true.

regex.description: Treat query as a case-insensitive regular expression.

kinds.description: Restrict to these object kinds, e.g. display-equation, figure, paragraph.

languageModelTools.name: paper_mathematicaBlocks
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the managed %Mathematica computation blocks in a .tex file and classify each as fresh, stale, modified-by-user, orphaned, malformed or no-output. Classification only: executing a block is not available yet. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

languageModelTools.name: paper_previewEdit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show what replacing one object's source would do, WITHOUT writing anything: the before/after text, the line delta, and any parse warnings the change would introduce. Returns the sourceHash to pass to paper_applyEdit. Read-only.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

new_text.description: Replacement source for the whole object, including its \\begin/\\end.

expected_source_hash.description: Reject unless the object's current source SHA-256 matches.

expected_source_prefix.description: Reject unless the current source starts with this.

languageModelTools.name: paper_applyEdit
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace one object's source in a .tex file via WorkspaceEdit, so the change is undoable with Cmd-Z. ALWAYS pass expected_source_hash from paper_getObject or paper_previewEdit: a stale edit is then rejected with a structured conflict naming the current hash, instead of overwriting a change you did not see. The file must be open in the editor.

file.description: Path to the .tex file. Absolute, workspace-relative, or a bare basename. Omit to use the active/only open .tex.

new_text.description: Replacement source for the whole object, including its \\begin/\\end.

expected_source_hash.description: Reject unless the object's current source SHA-256 matches. Strongly recommended.

expected_source_prefix.description: Reject unless the current source starts with this.
